text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival,
an event where the Umamusume can interact
with the fans who support them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stood near the school gate,
handing out pamphlets to visitors.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
No, it is not truly what one would call helping out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Since I have some free time, I'm standing here
to interact with the fans.
I thought having brochures on hand would be helpful.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Yaeno Muteki-san!
I'm a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Whether in a race or a Live, I just love how dignified Yaeno Muteki-san is!
I think she's so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Um... and then...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah... P-Please keep doing your best from now on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh... I haven't been able
to keep the conversation going at all...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you really can't say
Yaeno is particularly friendly, after all...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"We're used to it, but if it's your first time,
you might feel a bit intimidated."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
She's practically oozing that intense pressure
you only get from martial artists.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross, who happened to be passing by,
and the true-blue Edokko Umamusume, Inari One,
called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are caring by nature,
so they were likely looking out for Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! I see... Amiability...
Truthfully, I have not given much thought to that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, forcing yourself to act overly sweet
wouldn't really be like you, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, that unpolished grit is what makes Yaeno who she is,
and that's what the fans wanna see anyway, right?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then why not just make the most
of that unapproachable aura instead?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by "making the most of the atmosphere"...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just follow me for now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Gather 'round, gather 'round, step right up!
Serious game of Daifugo! Prizes for the winners!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Winning streak after winning streak with her "Invincible Poker Face"!
Are there no brave challengers worthy of facing Yaeno Muteki!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A serious match with Lady Yaeno Muteki...!?
I would be honored to participate as well!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I really love Yaeno Muteki's fiery spirit!
Though in Tycoon, maybe I'd actually have a shot at winning... Wanna give it a go?!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me, you over there. Would you care for some if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Me?
An invitation from Ya-Yaeno Muteki-san...
I'll do it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, count me in too!
Nothing gets true Edokko blood pumping like a competition!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright, let the match begin!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Dodged.
Next, please.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Passing right here?! Why?
We're still mid-game... Has she run out of moves?
No, could she be saving her trump card...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I can't read them!!
Their expression hasn't twitched in the slightest...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How do ya like that?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Heh, then I shall...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
!? What is this... this presence...
coming from Yaeno Muteki-dono...!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Fufu... This overwhelming aura... Is it warning this one not to make a blunder...!
Then let us duel!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"It's my turn, then.
Here I go."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? That pressure was meant to induce a blunder from me...!
I was careless, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oho, is this the end of that invincible poker face of yours?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You're wide open!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Pass!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's a wrap for today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see... So I took the bait hook, line, and sinker, huh?
I admit defeat!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"And that's the match!
First to finish, the winner is Yaeno!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"A-A live 'Osu' from Yaeno Muteki-san...!
To hear it so up close...! This is the best...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A serious duel with the revered Yaeno Muteki-dono has made me realize my own shortcomings.
Thank you very much for your guidance!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't intend it as formal instruction,
but if it proved helpful to your learning, nothing could please me more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Playing Daifugo with Yaeno Muteki-san
was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Interacting with everyone was a truly
meaningful experience for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Getting to interact with everyone in person like this will surely bring their faces to mind when I head into the race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Knowing what kind of people are supporting me
makes me feel all the more encouraged.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for spending time with me today.
I look forward to our continued relationship.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you really are so dutiful and polite!
Please let me keep cheering you on!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like this is the critical moment, huh?
Now then, what should we do...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What's this?! The air suddenly got so heavy...!
Ugh, what immense pressure...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the sheer fighting spirit
emanating from Yaeno Muteki-dono and Inari One-dono...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... what immense pressure...!
So this is what a serious showdown feels like...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text: S-So this is... the fiercely competitive world that Yaeno Muteki-san lives in...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: En garde!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text: ...Pass.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I got it!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That finishes things up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, outsmarted, huh...
Fine, you win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"And that's the match!
First to finish, the winner is Yaeno!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhh~!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Lady Yaeno Muteki!!
I felt your fighting spirit throughout the bout, and I am in awe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry I couldn't
come up with anything clever to say.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, while we were playing Daifugo,
I could truly feel your passion through the aura you were giving off, Yaeno Muteki-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like... going all-out against you
helped me get to know you better too!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Indeed,
it is in the midst of serious competition that my true essence lies.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To think you could feel that……!
Nothing could bring me greater joy!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget all of you,
nor the heated, earnest battle we shared today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, whenever I face a race,
everyone's faces will surely come to mind!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I thank you all from the bottom of my heart today!Please continue to give me your wonderful support!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Yaeno Muteki-san, you're surprisingly passionate!
I'm even more of a fan now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Inari-san, Tamamo-san,
thank you so much.
Thanks to you both, I was able to connect with the fans."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it, this sort of thing is a piece of cake!
Everyone's got their weak spots. Helping each other out is just what being human is all about!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"You hyped up our performance too, so that
makes us even!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I will never forget this kindness.
When the two of you are ever in trouble, it will be my turn to help.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously so earnest!
Well, that's what's great about ya, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Interacting directly with her fans seems to have given Yaeno Muteki a huge boost of encouragement!
